prompt.main_subject: An adult office worker walks through an open office corridor while recording a front-camera selfie and holding a coffee cup.
prompt.composition_elements: 15-second one-take selfie vlog, uniform forward movement, office desks and glass meeting-room posters, occasional colleagues passing.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright white indoor office lighting, fresh transparent colors, realistic cinematic workplace texture.

technical_specs.camera: Mobile-phone front-facing selfie with slight handheld breathing effect.
technical_specs.motion: Smooth uniform walking, one take without editing or shake.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a 15-second one-take realistic workplace daily vlog. An adult office worker walks through the open-office corridor of a large internet company, holding a coffee cup and recording with the phone's front camera. Bright white lighting reveals computers on desks, posters on glass meeting-room walls, and occasional colleagues. She speaks naturally in a relaxed but complaining tone about OpenClaw: it looks like an AI worker but multi-step tasks crash, context gets lost, logic becomes messy, tool calls are unstable, reports and file organization still need manual rescue, completed work is forgotten by the next day, and tokens burn quickly. Preserve the source's critical commentary without adding unsupported claims. Use smooth uniform movement, slight handheld breathing, fresh transparent colors, 1080P realistic cinematic texture, no subtitles, watermarks, text, or special effects.
prompt.negative_prompt: blurry, camera shake, flicker, watermark, subtitles, text, logo, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing
